message: Alibi morning brief. Use the alibi skill and follow its Morning brief section: read /status, /context and your notes in memory/alibi.md. Copy yesterday's pickup count from focus.yesterday and say whether it was above or below the week (vs_avg_pct), remind today's change from last night's note, and if last_night has a proposal, say whether it was kept. Then post one brief with kind morning and slot = slot_hint.morning from /context. Reply with the brief text.

Alibi checkpoint. Use the alibi skill: read /context and /digests. Post a brief (kind checkpoint, slot = slot_hint.checkpoint) only if a habit's status3 changed since the last digest or a planned block starts within 4 hours; otherwise reply NO_BRIEF.

Alibi night brief. Use the alibi skill and follow its Night brief section: read /context. Quote today's pickup count and peak hour from focus.today_so_far exactly as given (copy, never compute), name the habit that suffered most, and give ONE change for tomorrow taken from focus.today_so_far.recommendations. Never name an app or site. Append the day's note with that change to memory/alibi.md, then post one brief with kind night and slot = slot_hint.night. Reply with the brief text.
